rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when asking a person or god for help or guidance.

example.english: When I run into this kind of trouble, I have to invoke an expert for help.
example.traditional: 遇到呢種麻煩，我唯有向專家求助。
example.jyutping: jyu6 dou3 ne1 zung2 maa4 faan4 ngo5 wai4 jau5 hoeng3 zyun1 gaa1 kau4 zo6

rows.note: Use this in computing when causing a program, function, or subroutine to run.

example.english: The program uses a command to invoke this function.
example.traditional: 個程式用指令呼叫呢個函數。
example.jyutping: go3 cing4 sik1 jung6 zi2 ling6 fu1 giu3 ni1 go3 haam4 sou3

rows.note: Use this when citing a source or authority to support or validate a claim.

example.english: We invoke research by an expert to support this claim.
example.traditional: 為咗支持呢個講法，我哋引用咗權威專家嘅研究。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 ngo5 dei6 jan5 jung6 zo2 kyun4 wai1 zyun1 gaa1 ge3 jin4 gau3
